instruction: Delete the first slide from the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully duplicated the last two slides and inserted copies in alternating order in LibreOffice Impress, going from 24 to 26 slides. Completed in 38 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate slide panel, select slides, duplicate slides, move/reorder slides, save presentation in LibreOffice Impress
metadata.task_rationale: Tests slide deletion capability using the same presentation. Model demonstrated slide manipulation proficiency, so deletion is a related but different operation.
metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting the first slide. Evaluator checks: (1) slide count reduced from 24 to 23 (0.5 pts), (2) first slide now contains text from original slide 2 (0.5 pts).

scoring_breakdown.first_slide_content: 0.5 - First slide content matches original slide 2

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly downloads the pptx file and uses python-pptx to extract slide count and first slide text at index 0
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('expected_count') and expected.get('expected_first_text_contains') without wrapping
Both verification aspects are covered: slide count reduction (24→23) and content shift (new first slide contains original slide 2 text)
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state
Partial credit scoring (0.5 + 0.5) is well-designed for distinguishing partial from full completion
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: expected_first_text_contains value ('Understand the basic elements') cannot be independently verified without the actual file — ensure this matches the actual content of original slide 2
